Own web/viz.js (the 3D engine and nothing else): renders EVERY payment as one instanced column on the day × in-day-rank grid in raw WebGL — no three.js, no library, no exceptions. <canvas id='viz3d'> with a webgl or webgl2 context created {antialias:false, alpha:false} on the MAIN thread (no OffscreenCanvas, no Worker), backing store sized clientWidth × devicePixelRatio likewise for height so the image agrees with the projection math at any DPR; depth testing ON. Implements all five frozen mechanisms: (1) GPU picking via an offscreen framebuffer (RGBA8 color + depth attachment) sized exactly to the drawing buffer in device pixels, no MSAA, every instance drawn with identity color idNum = n+1 (n = stable arrival index, 0 = background) encoded r/g/b per the contract, decode idNum = r + 256·g + 65536·b → record id[idNum−1]; (2) orbit camera in degrees with inertia and the exact projection math (θ/φ from yaw/pitch, eye around T=(0,1,0), f/r/u basis, fovY 50°, k=1/tan(fovY/2), aspect Wcss/Hcss, near 0.5/far 1000, zc ≤ 0.5 does not project, CSS-px screen mapping); (3) deterministic screen-space label culling for the 12 records with highest a_major (ties by id ASC), anchored at project(x,h,z) of each instance's top-center under the live camera, eligible only when inside the canvas AND pick(A.sx,A.sy) returns that instance — occlusion-culled through the pick buffer; (4) the linked brush — ONE shared set of record ids with web-console's app.js, vs7dbg.brush() returning it sorted ascending by id, non-members rendered at 0.30 dim while members keep their exact status hex (graded by pixel probes on member and non-member tops); (5) live streaming diffs applied from SSE batches to instance data in place. Exposes window.vs7dbg with all eight synchronous methods exactly as specified: layout() {d0,D0,R0}, sceneDigest() {count,Sh,Sh2,Sx,Sz,Sxh,Szh,brushedCount} at 4 decimals, camera() live degrees and deg/s, setCamera(yaw,pitch,distance) applying clamps, cancelling any coast, rendering, re-culling labels, pick(sx,sy) {id,index} or null from the pick buffer occlusion-correct, pickPixel(sx,sy) raw [r,g,b,a] from the pick FBO at the same pixel mapping, brush(), frames() monotonic total. Consumes /api/viz/records (columnar, server-computed day — never recomputed client-side) and SSE /api/stream per the contracts owned by the api slice; the initial dataset comes from /api/viz/records, never from replay. Demand rendering keeps frames() increasing only when a frame is actually rendered. First non-background frame within 3 seconds of page load at full count (N = 12,288).
